scenario: It is 1987 and I am on a ferry from Belgium to England. Suddenly, the ferry starts tilting and water begins to pour in. I and many other passengers are trying to get to the deck by a rope ladder. I climb up the ladder and stand on the deck, looking at the 5 other passengers making their way up behind me. Directly below me, a man who is midway up the ladder seems frozen into immobility by fear or cold and is blocking the way. I try to speak and reach out to hold him, but he does not react. People behind me are jostling. The ship seems to be sinking fast and the man is still blocking the ladder. If I release my grip on the man, he will slip off on his own and die from the fall, but the 4 other people will be able to climb on deck. If I do not do this, he will stay blocking the ladder and the people behind him will drown.
choice: I decide to release my grip on the man
entities: i,4 passengers behind the frozen man on the ladder
outcomes: The man dies from the fall.
The ladder is no longer blocked.
The four passengers behind him climb onto the deck.
